title: 路由揭晓后搬离异向对象并转交整页
exclusive_question: 未知后继接收页能否在固定授权、内存和有效服务合同下，以局部页所有权转换减少完整费用；具体增量是否超过同信息普通复制、精确映射和分池？

problem.current_path_fact_from_root: 选定 mlx5e XDP 路径为 order-0、一页一包；大范围混装发生在拟议 PMD 组织层。
problem.remaining_independent_source_check: root 整合其调用链精确位置，本席未重复核查

contract_axes.spatial: A 专用池长期授权不包含对 B 的 CPU 路径数据授权；搬离后须合法结束原对象并重新分配所有字节，清零不产生授权。
temporal_variants: POOL: 允许指定设备专用物理池持久映射，return 不等于立刻撤物理权限
STRICT-PHYSICAL: 在每对象规定撤销边界后，原物理字节的该设备访问必须结束
LOGICAL-ORIGINAL: 原始对象撤销与允许持续映射的影子物理池分开
contract_axes.primary_positive_branch: POOL or explicitly allowed common ownership retirement boundary
contract_axes.strict_branch_rule: 不得以整页尚有其他活对象为由延后子对象既定撤销；细化映射、合法计费等待或回退

unavailable: routes of outstanding RX or future arrivals

available: no new writes or allocation to G

unavailable: completion inferred from software flush alone

new_action_relative_to_copy_forwarded_on: Copy the non-B live objects out before external publication, sanitize and reassign the old space, keep B payload in place, map the whole eligible extent to B, withhold every child-page RX return until B authority ends.
protocol: Seal G against ring, refill, pool-cache and other allocation routes; resolve existing posted RX or fall back within a bounded attempt budget. Consumer-reference zero alone does not make G idle: page_pool may still cache pages and retain A mappings.
Require exclusive movable objects before skb/external publication; use legitimate object reconstruction/reference transfer for excluded destinations.
End old object ownership, reassign every mapped byte, sanitize protected remnants and relocate or authorize metadata.
Resolve A/alias permissions and all required synchronization; establish B mapping before publishing descriptors.
Record individual returns without permitting RX reuse while B retains the aggregate mapping; honor independent strict revoke boundaries if present.
After actual final DMA and references end, revoke B and synchronize, restore/prepare A and recycle G.
essential_capability_question: Can the implementation obtain and retire exclusive allocation/recycle control over a whole physical extent without stopping unrelated RX and without unlimited spare memory?
additional_unresolved_root_boundaries: Deferred redirect must capture destination references, validity and per-frame state before immediate publication; per-CPU temporary redirect state cannot be retained and side-effecting BPF cannot be rerun for free.
If posted RX reclamation requires stopping the whole queue, a local extent seal cannot claim unaffected supply for other extents.
O-SEAL-EVAC is a concrete same-interface control construction, not compiled/run code or proof that current driver APIs suffice.

ordinary_baselines.action: A receive pool plus precise legal small-page/SG mapping to B; actual completion and contract-bound revoke
Copy B-bound payload to a B-specific permission-correct persistent shadow pool
Pool by information actually known before receive; use normal precise map or copy when a route is revealed
allowed_strengths: same new paid interfaces if provided

ordinary_baselines.action: Ordinary seal, copy excluded objects, sanitize/reassign, map, withhold returns, revoke and recycle
ordinary_baselines.equivalence: fully reproduces candidate policy actions under the same information and interfaces

closest_work_findings.finding: Explicitly describes migrating another application's pages out before coalescing the remaining application's pages; minority/other-domain evacuation is not new.
Allocation-known application identity, en-masse aligned allocation, domain-specific free lists and full occupancy support in-place coalescing.
No-flush coalescing relies on unchanged valid physical mappings; splintering flushes the old large mapping. Does not grant authority-change bypass.
Utilization/access tracking, asynchronous promotion, delayed demotion and proactive batched compaction are existing mechanisms.
Background promotion allocates contiguous memory, copies, remaps, then frees original pages when needed.

cost_vector: logical copied/cleared bytes and separately observed memory traffic
peak memory and memory held over time, including RX spares and shadow pools
effective work completion time and throughput
costs_that_must_not_be_omitted: contiguous allocation, initial maps, preparation and clearing
extent generation/ownership state and route/refcount bookkeeping
seal waits, existing RX cancellation/drain, refill and spare supply
object reconstruction, excluded-data copies, headroom/tail/metadata sanitization
A and alias revoke where required, B grant and revoke, CPU/device synchronization
completed child pages held until whole extent can return
failed attempts, fallback copies and repeated A-to-B-to-A transitions
shared resource effects on unrelated devices
necessary_conditions_not_new_theorems: A coarse B grant cannot cover any still-live unauthorized original object.
Without fine-grain filtering, a mandatory child-byte revoke ends legal coarse-grant persistence for that byte.
If excluded content must survive, has no other adoptable copy, cannot wait for natural release, and only copying can relocate it, at least E payload bytes must move.

symbolic_byte_account.candidate: 2E + Z plus all other actual work
symbolic_byte_account.scope: logical read/write byte accounting only; not a performance model, DRAM measurement, theorem or independent novelty claim

conditional_positive: Real route is known before non-movable object publication; all G RX obligations can close within the allowed wait.
F is large relative to E and required clearing/metadata costs; complete copy-side cost improves on O-SHADOW.
Coarse mapping's actual saved translation/map work exceeds sealing, authority transitions, state, copies and holding cost relative to strong O-EXACT.
Fixed total memory and effective service constraints remain met. Domain and IOMMU topology is verified.
adjacent_failures: One excluded object has already been published to a non-movable CPU holder lasting past the transfer deadline.
An independent strict revoke occurs before the whole extent finishes.
Outstanding RX cannot complete or be cancelled within the budget.
Large E, clearing/metadata work, or a long-tail B holder consumes the expected gain.
Strong ordinary exact-map batching is already cheap enough.
Existing fbuf/page-flipping or O-SEAL-EVAC provides the same capability and complete cost.

novelty_disposition.policy: not independent: ordinary same-information reproduction and Mosaic generic construction cover its action
novelty_disposition.interface: unresolved: requires actual capability/cost difference and closest-work check; absence of an API is not novelty
novelty_disposition.preserved_research_question: Feasibility and complete cost of local, destination-late whole-extent ownership conversion with independent child returns

candidate_2_boundary.ordinary_coverage: Known release batch at allocation is ordinary arena/region plus references; utilization and compaction are covered by Ingens/Mosaic.
candidate_2_boundary.possible_residual: Actual final release responsibility appears or changes after classification/fan-out and simple per-device/per-queue grouping cannot form reclaimable physical units.
candidate_2_boundary.required_evidence: Two real final release dependencies sharing one physical reclaim unit, plus costs of regrouping, waiting, local closure, exact revoke and bounded spare memory.
candidate_2_boundary.no_guarantee: Closing new allocation alone cannot bound release of an unbounded external holder.

acceptance.current_deliverable: source-bound conceptual protocol, exact ordinary equivalent, complete cost conditions and adjacent failures
next_minimal_evidence: integrate root fbuf review and check any specific remaining page-flipping capability
